records.jp: うーん、ここまで色々な思い出を<CR>見た気がしますけど……
records.en_original: Hmm, all of these memories so far feel familiar...
records.en: Hmm, all of these memories so far feel familiar...

records.jp: 結局あの構造物については謎のまま、か…………
records.en_original: But that structure is still a mystery...
records.en: But that structure is still a mystery...

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: ――――いや、待ってください
records.en_original: Please wait.
records.en: Please wait.

records.jp: 私……あれを知っている気がします
records.en_original: I...may know what that is.
records.en: I...may know what that is.

records.en_original: Really?!
records.en: Really?!

records.jp: ど、どういうこと！？
records.en_original: Wh-what do you mean?!
records.en: Wh-what do you mean?!

records.jp: いや、ごめんなさい。<CR>確かなことは何一つ言えないのですが……
records.en_original: I can't say anything with certainty, but...
records.en: I can't say anything with certainty, but...

records.jp: あの存在を見た瞬間から、<CR>何か胸に引っかかるような感触があるんです
records.en_original: The moment I saw it, I felt something pulling at my heart.
records.en: The moment I saw it, I felt something pulling at my heart.

records.jp: うたちんはまだ記憶を取り戻していない……
records.en_original: Uta still hasn't gotten her memories back.
records.en: Uta still hasn't gotten her memories back.

records.jp: 詩が記憶を取り戻せば、<CR>あれについて何か分かるかもしれない……？
records.en_original: Perhaps we'll be able to learn more about it once she does...?
records.en: Perhaps we'll be able to learn more about it once she does...?

records.jp: で、でも待ってよ！<CR>駒川さんのココロトープに行ったら――
records.en_original: W-wait! If we go to Komagawa's Heartscape...
records.en: W-wait! If we go to Komagawa's Heartscape...

records.jp: そうだね、またクラックが発生する可能性がある……
records.en_original: That's right, there's a possibility of another Crack forming.
records.en: That's right, there's a possibility of another Crack forming.

records.jp: ど、どうする…………？
records.en_original: What do you think...?
records.en: What do you think...?

records.jp: 今の詩ちゃんなら大丈夫――<CR>私はそう信じたいよ
records.en_original: I believe in the Uta we know now.
records.en: I believe in the Uta we know now.

records.jp: 過去と向き合う……そのために、<CR>私たちも詩に話をしてきたから
records.en_original: Uta has the strength to face her past. She already spoke with us about it.
records.en: Uta has the strength to face her past. She already spoke with us about it.

records.jp: 私たちは、ずっと悩んでた詩ちゃんを見てきた
records.en_original: We've seen Uta struggle every day.
records.en: We've seen Uta struggle every day.

records.jp: 悩むってことは……<CR>それだけ真剣に考えてるってことだと思うんだ
records.en_original: We know just how seriously she's been taking all of this.
records.en: We know just how seriously she's been taking all of this.

records.jp: あの時、星崎さんのココロトープに<CR>行こうという話になって、少し安心してしまったんです
records.en_original: When we decided to go to Ao's Heartscape, I felt relieved.
records.en: When we decided to go to Ao's Heartscape, I felt relieved.

records.jp: よかった、私じゃなかった
records.en_original: Relieved that it wasn't me.
records.en: Relieved that it wasn't me.

records.jp: これでみなさんの迷惑にならなくて済む、って
records.en_original: I thought, maybe I wouldn't have to cause more trouble for everyone.
records.en: I thought, maybe I wouldn't have to cause more trouble for everyone.

records.jp: でも、それじゃダメなんです。<CR>やっぱり私も……行かなくちゃいけない
records.en_original: But that's not enough anymore. We must go to my Heartscape.
records.en: But that's not enough anymore. We must go to my Heartscape.

records.jp: 詩さん……
records.en_original: Uta...
records.en: Uta...

records.jp: もう一度、行かせてくれませんか。<CR>私は……私の過去と、向き合いたい
records.en_original: Let me go back. I...I must face my past.
records.en: Let me go back. I...I must face my past.

records.jp: ……私からもお願い
records.en_original: I also want to go.
records.en: I also want to go.

records.jp: あの時とは違う。私たちも、詩さんも
records.en_original: It won't be like last time. We won't make the same mistakes.
records.en: It won't be like last time. We won't make the same mistakes.

records.jp: 私たちが先に進むには、<CR>全員が全員を信じないといけないと思う
records.en_original: We all have to believe in each other if we want to move forward.
records.en: We all have to believe in each other if we want to move forward.

records.jp: それはきっと、詩さんも例外じゃない
records.en_original: Uta is no different.
records.en: Uta is no different.

records.jp: 駒川さんとは、何度も戦いました。<CR>今でも受け入れられないことがたくさんあります
records.en_original: I fought against Uta many times. There are still some things I can't accept.
records.en: I fought against Uta many times. There are still some things I can't accept.

records.jp: 駒川さんは、間違いなくわたしたちの敵だった。<CR>それをなかったことにはできない
records.en_original: Uta was our enemy. We can't forget that.
records.en: Uta was our enemy. We can't forget that.

records.jp: ……でも同じように、<CR>この世界で過ごした日々もなくならない
records.en_original: But we also can't forget the days we spent together in this world...
records.en: But we also can't forget the days we spent together in this world...

records.jp: ……そうですね
records.en_original: ...You're right.
records.en: ...You're right.

records.jp: わたしは、この世界で共に過ごした<CR>「駒川詩」を信じます
records.en_original: I trust the Uta Komagawa we have come to know in this world.
records.en: I trust the Uta Komagawa we have come to know in this world.

records.jp: 全員の力が必要、か……
records.en_original: We'll need everyone's strength...
records.en: We'll need everyone's strength...

records.jp: 分かった。ライムも……詩ちゃんを信じるよ
records.en_original: Okay. I'll trust you too, Uta...
records.en: Okay. I'll trust you too, Uta...

records.jp: リベンジしよう、詩ちゃんのココロトープ
records.en_original: Let's go back to Uta's Heartscape and do it right this time!
records.en: Let's go back to Uta's Heartscape and do it right this time!

records.jp: ……私の方こそ、よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: Thank you for trusting me...
records.en: Thank you for trusting me...

records.jp: 私の心の中にある、あの構造物……<CR>それを知っているかもしれない詩さん……
records.en_original: Who knew Uta would know something about a weird thing in my heart...
records.en: Who knew Uta would know something about a weird thing in my heart...

records.jp: まさか、私のココロトープで<CR>こんなことになるなんて思わなかった
records.en_original: I never thought my Heartscape would be like this.
records.en: I never thought my Heartscape would be like this.

records.jp: ……うん、ユズもびっくり
records.en_original: Me neither...
records.en: Me neither...

records.jp: 結局、両方のココロトープに行くことになったね
records.en_original: We all had to go to our Heartscapes in the end, huh.
records.en: We all had to go to our Heartscapes in the end, huh.

records.jp: 希望を見出すには全員の力が必要……<CR>もしかしたら、そういうことなのかもしれないね
records.en_original: Maybe it's about us all giving everything we have to find hope.
records.en: Maybe it's about us all giving everything we have to find hope.

records.jp: ……うん。感覚だけど、<CR>私もそうなんじゃないかって思う
records.en_original: Yeah... I get the feeling that's got to be it.
records.en: Yeah... I get the feeling that's got to be it.
